thread:
sre_taylor: :rotating_light: We're seeing incidentbot fail to fanout pages to PagerDuty. Multiple services reporting delayed pages; EU customers affected.
chris: I'm pulling the last 15m of pagerbridge logs now.
incidentbot: delivery failed -> service=pagerbridge endpoint=/v1/pager/send status=500 attempts=3
maria: Can we manual page the oncall? @oncall_lead
oncall_lead: I didn't get paged. Manual page pls and escalate to eng-infra if it's widespread.
sre_taylor: Manual PD page created (PD-7891) and assigned to oncall. Notifying CS to start outreach.
devops: Quick log snippet: upstream error from pd-proxy, stack shows upstream read timeout and worker OOMs. Pasting sample below:
```
curl -X POST "https://pagerbridge.local/v1/pager/send" -d '{"payload":...}' -i
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Server: pagerbridge
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "upstream read timeout" }
```
chris: Looks like one pagerbridge worker is OOMing and backlog is growing. I'm kicking a rolling restart now.
incidentbot: deploy activity: redeploy/pagerbridge v2.3.1 initiated by deploybot
deploybot: rolling restart started (3 pods)
maria: While they restart, we need a fallback. Can someone flip the channel-level SMS fallback and forward PD alerts to #eng-oncall?
ops_lead: Running forwarding script now: `/scripts/forward_pd_to_sms.sh --since=1817654000`
ops_lead: Forwarding active. Will post confirmation when first batch sent.
sre_taylor: @customer-success can you confirm which customers got delayed notifications so we can notify them proactively?
customer-success: Starting outreach for 2 impacted EU customers (acct: EU-331, EU-442). Notifying legal for SLA tracking.
chris: Restart finished on 3/3 pods. Monitoring queue depth and fanout.
devops: Earlier metric dump: `fanout=partial, delivered=42/96, error_rate=0.56` at ~minute mark 1817654230.
oncall_lead: I received a manual PD page at 1817654290 and acknowledged. No new automatic pages for me after that.
maria: Note for post-incident: add an early circuit-breaker for partial fanout and better retry jitter to avoid thundering herd.
sre_taylor: Filing incident ticket INC-2026, severity: Sev2 for pager integration. Owners: @chris @devops @maria. Add timeline and payload captures.
chris: Root cause hypothesis: worker memory pressure + GC pause created backlog; retries coupled with synchronous fanout caused partial delivery. Hotfix: increase worker memory and enable backpressure.
devops: Hotfix deployed (worker mem -> 3GB, enable backpressure flag). Watching for regressions.
incidentbot: fanout normalizing; pages resumed normal fanout at 1817654500.
maria: Confirming no new missed pages after 1817654500. Live mitigation complete, switching to postmortem.
ops_lead: Runbook action: if pagerbridge partial_fanout_ratio > 0.3 for >1m, automatically enable SMS fallback and open incident ticket.
sre_taylor: Good catch everyone. Please add logs/payloads to INC-2026 and schedule a follow-up to harden PD integration.
chris: I'll attach heap dumps and GC traces. Follow-up PR for retry/backoff is in progress.
customer-success: Outreach complete; both customers acknowledged and have a support ticket.
maria: Closing live coordination thread. Follow-up doc in /docs/incidents/pagerbridge-integration.md (draft). :thumbsup:
ops_lead: :thumbsup: 
incidentbot: end of incident updates
